subject.title: fix(config): demote tool policy allowlists to advanced settings tier

question: Should the settings experience treat restrictive allowlists, per-sender/provider policy, and elevated access as advanced operational controls while keeping routine tool profile, deny, and also-allow controls in the default view?
rationale: The patch changes a curated operator-facing information hierarchy rather than runtime behavior, and the repository’s protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision on that presentation boundary.

options.title: Confirm the advanced-tier boundary
options.body: Accept the proposed grouping after a real settings-flow capture verifies that the controls remain discoverable under Show advanced.

options.title: Keep selected policy controls common
options.body: Name any policy paths that must remain immediately visible, then adjust the curated path list and snapshot to preserve that narrower default view.

recommendation.title: Confirm the advanced-tier boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed grouping after a real settings-flow capture verifies that the controls remain discoverable under Show advanced.
